mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.10% and remains below this threshold for two consecutive months, it signals a near-zero interest rate environment that stimulates risk-taking and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been below 0.10% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls signal a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer demand regimes (RSAFS above 12-month moving average), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS is above 12mo MA and HOUST rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months indicates expanding manufacturing capacity and rising corporate output, which correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has increased for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.0% and remains elevated for three consecutive months, it signals economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has been above 6.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising gross domestic product (GDPC1) at a quarterly pace signals robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 has grown at a quarterly pace.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals a central bank response to inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS declines.
